تقتضوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَضُوا (taqtaḍū) /taq.ta.dˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# تُقْتَضَوْا (tuqtaḍaw) /tuq.ta.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
